summary: 资本回报与政策空间是坏消息侧:投资效率持续下降(ICOR 1991–2003均约4.1、高于日韩台高增长期),增长债务驱动;2024非金融部门债务约GDP 312%、增广债务124%、地方政府>60%——资本深化引擎衰竭叠加高杠杆,压缩政策腾挪、削弱抵消项兑现能力。

evidence.title: DOC-0009
evidence.quote: China's average ICOR for the years 1991 to 2003 was 4.1, which was comparatively higher than that for Japan, South Korea and Taiwan.

evidence.title: DOC-0011
evidence.quote: The overall non-financial debt increased to 312% of GDP in 2024 from 245%.

evidence.title: DOC-0011
evidence.quote: Augmented debt, which includes LGFVs, has increased to 124% of GDP from 86.3%.

open_questions: 主权货币+资本管制+国有银行能否使高债务比日本更可控,存争议
